amendment_reason: Calibration on three stimuli did not hold the budget on independent stimuli, and ordinary least-squares readout extrapolated unstably in the initial network. These measurement failures require an online budget controller and calibration-only regularization selection. All failed preflight outputs are retained.
budget: E+I total spikes/s, equal cost per spike. Activity proxy, not ATP or joules.
controller: A common E/I threshold multiplier updates every 20 ms: log(gain) += 0.12*(block_count/(target*0.02)-1), constrained to [0.03,20]. Same controller in both endpoint networks. Synaptic weights remain frozen.
primary_response: Spike count across all 375 cells, with fixed count support and equal weighting over templates and repeats. E-only and I-only checks are secondary.
readout: Centered linear ridge decoder. Select alpha from [0.0001,0.001,0.01,0.1,1,10,100] by leave-one-calibration-template-out reconstruction error. Refit on all calibration templates and score only independent test templates.
inference: Fixed two endpoints from one archived training run. Test templates/repeats do not become independent training runs.
decision: Require achieved activity within 5% of target, finite stable predictions, and matched simulator checks before interpretation. Preserve all time scales and both endpoints regardless of sign.
scope: Direct network intervention on the evaluation budget; not a new budget-constrained learning rule or evidence of convergence across independent trainings.
